contracts.provenance: Format example only: the double-precision bound of the illustrative cases' own tolerance. Not a guarantee of any rule

contracts.regime: MAR40 as in force from 2023-01-01: the shorthand method, with net positions of at most 1e9 in the reporting currency
contracts.provenance: The default absolute tolerance of a derived value (calculation contracts, Decisions): the two quantities are sums and one product of amounts in Double arithmetic, which agree to far more digits. A draft: it has one holdout case, and its calibration case holds illustrative values only

contracts.regime: MAR40 as in force from 2023-01-01: the maturity method, with weighted positions of at most 1e10 in the reporting currency
contracts.provenance: The tolerance of the published values of example C.2 of SRC-03: its positions are printed to 0.01 mn, and the rounding of 13.33 mn moves a printed charge by at most 0.005 mn x 3.75% = 187.5, which the tolerance of 500 covers. A draft: it has two holdout cases, and its calibration case holds illustrative values only
